# Readme-ai
Welcome to Readme-ai, the AI-powered tool that helps you generate and customize READMEs for your projects.

Installation
To get started with Readme-ai, first install the package using pip:

pip install readme-ai
Quickstart
To generate a README for an existing repository, run the following command:

readme-ai scan <repository-url>
Or use the UI to generate a README within your repository.

Usage
Readme-ai provides a simple command-line interface or a web-based UI to help you create a README. The generated README will be based on the code in your repository, including links to the code and any issues or pull requests.

For more advanced customization, check the documentation.
